nature: exploratory; run at B's explicit request AFTER the registered pre-check verdict was 'stop' (configs/future_A/precheck.json, results/tables/future_A/precheck/decision.json). It does not overturn that verdict and never replaces any registered result. Test is not read.
question: At the 2010-12-01 time point, if customers are re-labelled from their Discovery RFM AND the group rules are re-mined on Discovery baskets by the new groups, do the group rules cover more Validation orders than the current static deployment, than G, and than activity-matched random regrouping?

inputs.baskets: as configs/extra_eval/common.json (A snapshot 2ae672b, eligible baskets, taxonomy_v1 l2, P5 rules, rule_id as C)
inputs.new_labels: P1 labels of the pre-check: Discovery-window RFM (cutoff 2010-12-01) assigned with the frozen scaler and centroids of results/tables/future_A/frozen_scaler_centroids.json; recomputed by the same code and asserted identical to the pre-check's P1 group sizes (1,053 / 829 / 802)

systems.L_orig: Profile labels; rules mined on Discovery by Profile groups; customers use their Profile group's rules (= E9/E10 L)
systems.L_swap: L_orig's lists, customers use the list of their new label (E9 only; = pre-check P4 swap_P1)
systems.L_new: new labels; rules re-mined on Discovery baskets by the new groups; customers use their new group's rules
systems.A1: existing A1 controls (seeds 1000-1099): reference null for L_orig
systems.A2p: new null for L_new: the new labels shuffled within strata of eligible Discovery basket counts (same strata as A2: 0, 1, 2, 3-4, 5-9, 10+), seeds 2000-2099, using clustering.activity_control.matched_permutations; per-stratum label counts asserted equal to the real new labels

evaluations.E9_primary: same slots per customer (E9 construction), budgets 20/50/100, primary budget 100, order coverage on Validation; customer-macro coverage alongside
evaluations.E10: variants V1_restricted, V1_shared, V3_shared (E10 construction), budgets 20/50/100; descriptive
evaluations.E5a: group-specific rule selection and Discovery -> Validation direction retention (E5 construction, top 10 per group) for L_new and every A2p seed; L_orig and A1 from the same code for reference; descriptive
evaluations.E5b: marginal coverage of 10 group-specific slots on top of G's top 50 (E5 primary setting B0=50, k=10, unconfirmed version) for L_new vs A2p; descriptive
evaluations.sensitivity: E9 at budget 100 restricted to baskets of customers who were active in the Discovery window (silent customers removed); descriptive

primary_hypothesis.H_R2: E9, budget 100, Validation order coverage: L_new - L_orig, paired customer bootstrap (2,000 repeats, seed 20261121)

interpretation.refresh_helps: interval above 0 AND L_new at or above the A2p 95th percentile (empirical p <= 0.05)
interpretation.refresh_helps_like_any_split: interval above 0 but L_new not above the A2p 95th percentile

secondary: L_new - G (paired interval): does refreshing close the gap to G?
L_new - L_swap (paired interval): what re-mining adds beyond swapping lists

known_information_before_registration: Pre-check results: 6-month label retention 51% (kappa 0.28); swapping lists to new labels -0.25 pp [-0.68, +0.20]; oracle gain +3.13 pp equals the A1 oracle gain (median +3.33); registered verdict 'stop'.
E9/E10/E5 Validation results for L_orig, G and A1.
No list has been mined by the new labels; no A2p seed exists.
